In order to dilute Pt content in the surface, annealing treatment (600 °C for 2 h and 1050 °C for 1 h with the vacuum lower than < 6 × 10-3 Pa) was conducted prior to aluminising (naming ''prior annealing'' hereafter).

Aluminising treatment was conducted at 1060 °C for 6 h with the samples hanging above the aluminising pack. Powder of Fe-49 wt% Al was used as the Al source and NH4Cl (2.0 wt%) was used as the activator for aluminising.

other.solution: K2[Pt(NO2)2SO4] acid solution with micro-sized metallic hafnium particles (0.1–10 µm in diameter)

evidence.quote: Pt + Hf composite plating layer with the same thickness was electroplated by adding micro-sized metallic hafnium (0.1–10 lm in diameter) particles into the Pt-plating solution. As the commercially available hafnium particle is 99.5 wt% and 500 mesh in size, the hafnium particles were grinded in an agate container filled with agate balls for about 1 week.

other.cycle: 50 min in furnace + 10 min air cooling

evidence.quote: Cyclic oxidation performance was conducted in static air at 1100 °C by a horizontal tube furnace equipped with an automatic lift. A complete cycle includes maintaining coating specimens inside the furnace for 50 min and then taking out from the furnace with air cooling for 10 min.
